top_signals.title: Japan Tobacco Shares Fall After Russia-Related Charges
top_signals.summary: Japan Tobacco Inc. shares declined after the cigarette maker said it expects to swing to an operating loss and slashed its dividend forecast after losing control of its Russian business.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
